summary: MetaMCP 2.4.22, PostgreSQL, registry bootstrap, OAuth endpoint configuration, and five child-server lanes validate, but Loki and Kubernetes do not expose tools in the live homelab endpoint.
validation: PR #440 merged as c7f409922f85efc900b27f61f20ac1a355380771; Argo metamcp is Synced/Healthy and PostgreSQL runs the verified amd64 digest.
Protected bootstrap completed successfully and the seven requested servers are registered with ACTIVE Observability mappings.
Streamable HTTP initialize and tools/list succeeded with 72 tools; ArgoCD, GitHub-p, GitHub-p_Actions, Prometheus, and Tempo prefixes are present.
Prometheus health_check returned healthy with homelab URL http://prometheus.observability.svc.cluster.local:80.
Safe calls succeeded for Tempo attribute discovery, ArgoCD application listing, GitHub identity, and GitHub Actions workflow listing.
Loki is absent because grafana-mcp is not deployed; Kubernetes is absent because its child reports no current kube context despite projected read-only RBAC.
Argo Application grafana-mcp is now present but InvalidSpec because default AppProject does not allow https://grafana-community.github.io/helm-charts.
blockers: A durable GitOps fix is required for the Grafana Helm repository allowlist and Kubernetes child environment/in-cluster startup.
Public mcp.rickebo.com and auth.rickebo.com DNS are unresolved from this workstation; ChatGPT OAuth cannot be externally verified until DNS/AuthentiK exposure is live.
next_action: Route to code for the minimal child-server/AppProject remediation, merge and reconcile it, then rerun all seven server discovery and safe-call checks before completing OAuth validation.
independent_lanes: Grafana MCP AppProject and service reconciliation
Public OAuth DNS and Authentik boundary
